name: Reject ICA components
summary: Removes selected ICA components from continuous MEG/EEG with MNE-Python ICA.apply(), optionally auto-detecting EOG and ECG components, and outputs the cleaned raw data with an overlay plot and report.
description: Reads a fitted ICA object (for example from ICA-fit) and the raw data, excludes the union of components already marked in the ICA, those listed in exclude and, if enabled, those found by find_bads_eog/find_bads_ecg, then reconstructs the signal. Use it to remove ocular or cardiac artifacts after fitting ICA on the same data.

inputs.description: Fitted ICA decomposition of the same data (e.g. from ICA-fit).

outputs.description: Raw data with the excluded ICA components removed (raw.fif).
Overlay plot of the signal before and after ICA application.
HTML QC report with the ICA decomposition and excluded components.

parameters.description: The indices referring to columns in the ummixing matrix. The components to be zeroed out. If None (default) or an empty list, only components from ica.exclude will be excluded. Else, the union of exclude and ica.exclude will be excluded.
Detect and reject EOG related components using correlation (using mne.preprocessing.ICA.find_bads_eog)
Detect and reject ECG related components using correlation (using mne.preprocessing.ICA.find_bads_ecg)
Comma separated EOG channel number(s) or label(s)
Comma separated ECG channel number(s) or label(s)
